✳ LANG LOG

by yoshi

An atlas of language families, sign languages and writing systems. Every placement says which source it follows, competing classifications are shown together, and the data can be downloaded.

  • Language families

    Glottolog's classification of every language family, language and dialect, with WALS and published study trees side by side and the clades they disagree on.

    27,177Glottolog records
    30Imported study trees
    433Records in conflicting clades

  • Sign languages

    Sign languages and their proposed relationships, from catalogs, manual alphabets and lexical studies.

    344Glottolog sign records
    76Manual-alphabet samples
    19Languages in lexical study

  • Writing systems

    Scripts and notations, how they descend from and influence each other, and which languages use them.

    334Script / notation records
    63Reviewed relationships
    1,001CLDR usage assertions

Also

  • All families and isolates: one plain page per Glottolog record, with its classification and a map.
  • Corpora and data for low-resource languages: planned.
